name: delete_file
description: Delete a file or directory. Set recursive to true to remove a directory and all of its contents. Use absolute paths. When the user does not specify a location, default to the current working directory from the system context. Example: {"path":"<cwd>/output/profile.html"}

path.description: Absolute path of the file or directory to delete. Default to the current working directory when no path is given.

recursive.description: If true, remove directories recursively. Otherwise only empty directories can be removed.
